items.title_zh: 宝武11月板材价格总体平盘，媒体称以减产稳价和出口分流为支撑
items.title_en: Baowu keeps November flat-product prices unchanged, with output restraint and exports cited as support
items.title_original: Baowu Steel announced flat prices for November
items.summary_zh: Yieh公开报道显示，中国宝武11月价格采取全面平盘策略。报道把这一决定解释为成本上升、利润受压背景下以减产稳价，并称国内消费增长仍温和、年末刺激尚未充分显效，10—11月出口分流、海外制造业补库及对四季度政策的预期提供支撑。Mysteel另确认宝钢股份10月10日价格通知维持11月国内销售主要板材（包括热卷）牌价不变。报道未列出各产品、规格、基地的绝对出厂价或出口报价。
items.summary_en: Yieh reports that China Baowu kept November prices unchanged across the board, describing the move as price support through output restraint amid higher costs and compressed margins. It cites modest domestic consumption, incomplete year-end stimulus effects, October-November export diversion, overseas restocking and fourth-quarter policy expectations. Mysteel separately confirms that Baosteel's 10 October notice held November domestic list prices for major flat products, including HRC, unchanged. Neither public excerpt supplies absolute mill prices by product, specification or works, or export quotations.
items.impact_zh: 平盘是月度定价信号，不等于所有宝武基地、钢种和出口合同价格不变，也不证明已执行统一减产。中国出口业务可把它作为短期底价和钢厂利润压力参考，但仍应按具体牌号、基地、数量、交期、退税/运费和目的地重新询价；对“出口增长”和政策预期属于媒体市场判断，不应当作确定订单或政策。
items.impact_en: The rollover is a monthly pricing signal, not proof that every Baowu mill, grade or export contract is unchanged, nor evidence of a uniform production cut. Export teams can use it as a short-term floor and margin signal but should re-quote by grade, works, volume, delivery, tax/freight and destination. Media commentary on exports and policy expectations is not confirmed order flow or policy.
items.source_excerpt: Baowu Steel announced flat prices for November Yieh Corp.
items.coverage: 2026-10-14已通读Yieh公开全文，并交叉核对Mysteel公开标题及首段；覆盖平盘方向、报道给出的市场解释和热卷等主要板材范围，未取得宝钢股份原始完整价格表，未推断各规格绝对价格或出口加价。

items.title_original: Boltless Steel Shelving Units Prepackaged for Sale From the People's Republic of China: Continuation of Antidumping Duty Order and Countervailing Duty Order
items.summary_zh: 美国商务部在第二次五年日落复审后，因商务部与美国国际贸易委员会分别认定撤销措施可能导致倾销、可诉补贴和实质损害继续或再现，决定自2026年9月29日起延续A-570-018、C-570-019反倾销与反补贴令。美国海关将继续按进口时有效税率征收现金保证金。本令覆盖预包装销售、主要无需螺母螺栓或螺钉组装的钢制货架单元及加装套件，可带或不带层板；书面范围优先于列示的HTSUS 9403.20.0018、9403.20.0020、9403.20.0025、9403.20.0026及可能使用的9403.10.0040。壁挂式货架、一体式金属丝货架、散装零部件和定制货架系统明确排除。
items.summary_en: Following the second sunset reviews, Commerce continued AD order A-570-018 and CVD order C-570-019 effective 29 September 2026 because Commerce and the ITC found that revocation would likely cause dumping, countervailable subsidies and material injury to continue or recur. CBP will keep collecting cash deposits at the rates in effect on entry. The written scope covers prepackaged boltless steel shelving units and add-on kits, with or without decks; cited HTSUS lines are 9403.20.0018, 9403.20.0020, 9403.20.0025 and 9403.20.0026, with possible entry under 9403.10.0040. Wall-mounted units, integrated wire shelving, bulk-packed parts and made-to-order systems are excluded.
items.impact_zh: 这是现有贸易救济令的正式延续，不是新立案，也未在本通知中公布统一新税率。对美出口货架及套件应先按书面产品描述核对范围，再确认出口商/生产商对应的现行AD和CVD现金保证金率；不能只凭HTSUS编码或“无螺栓”商品名称判断是否落入措施。
items.impact_en: This formally continues existing trade-remedy orders; it is not a new investigation and does not announce a single new rate. U.S.-bound shelving and kits require written-scope analysis and confirmation of the exporter/producer-specific current AD and CVD cash-deposit rates; HTSUS codes or a boltless trade name alone are not dispositive.

items.source_excerpt: As a result of the determinations by the U.S. Department of Commerce (Commerce) and the U.S. International Trade Commission (ITC) that revocation of the antidumping duty (AD) and countervailing duty (CVD) orders on boltless steel shelving units prepackaged for sale from (boltless steel shelving) the People's Republic of China (China) would likely lead to the continuation or recurrence of dumping, countervailable subsidies, and material injury to an industry in the United States, Commerce is publishing a notice of continuation of these AD and CVD orders.

items.title_en: USITC finds injury likely to recur if China non-refillable steel-cylinder orders are revoked
items.title_original: Non-Refillable Steel Cylinders From China; Determinations
items.summary_zh: 美国国际贸易委员会在701-TA-644和731-TA-1494五年复审中认定，撤销对华非重复充装钢瓶反倾销与反补贴令，可能在可合理预见期间导致美国国内产业实质损害继续或再现；一名委员未参加。复审于2026年4月1日启动、7月6日决定采用快速复审，委员会于10月8日完成并提交决定，意见载于USITC Publication 5799。本通知是损害复审结论，不含企业税率，也不是新的调查。
items.summary_en: In five-year review investigations 701-TA-644 and 731-TA-1494, the USITC determined that revoking the AD and CVD orders on non-refillable steel cylinders from China would likely lead to continuation or recurrence of material injury within a reasonably foreseeable time; one commissioner did not participate. The reviews began on 1 April 2026, were expedited on 6 July and were completed and filed on 8 October, with the Commission's views in USITC Publication 5799. The notice is an injury-review determination, not a new investigation or company duty-rate notice.
items.impact_zh: 该肯定性结论支持现有AD/CVD令继续维持；受影响出口商不能据此推导自身税率。对美出口便携式非重复充装钢瓶，应核对商务部书面范围、容量和充装状态，以及出口商/生产商对应的最新行政复审与现金保证金率；等待商务部发布正式延续通知并更新报关指引。
items.impact_en: The affirmative injury finding supports continuation of the existing AD/CVD orders but does not establish an exporter-specific rate. Exporters of portable non-refillable steel cylinders should check Commerce's written scope, capacity and filling status, and the current review/cash-deposit rate for the exporter-producer combination, then monitor Commerce's continuation notice and entry guidance.

items.title_zh: Trasteel CEO估算钢铁CBAM成本或达每年50亿欧元：企业观点并非官方测算
items.title_en: Trasteel CEO estimates steel CBAM costs could reach €5bn a year; this is not an official calculation
items.title_original: CBAM costs for steel products could reach €5 billion a year — Trasteel CEO
items.summary_zh: GMK转述Trasteel首席执行官Gianfranco Imperato接受Platts采访时称，钢铁产品CBAM总成本可能达到每年50亿欧元，并最终更多转嫁给消费者。他表示欧洲需求疲弱目前抑制明显涨价，供应地正在按进口配额调整；俄乌板坯供应缺失后，公司增加了远东采购。他还认为不确定性压制新增产能投资，PPGI等短缺更可能通过提高既有产能利用率弥补。50亿欧元没有披露计算模型、产品范围、排放强度或证书价格假设，属于企业高管情景判断。
items.summary_en: GMK reports that Trasteel CEO Gianfranco Imperato told Platts total CBAM costs for steel products could reach €5bn annually and ultimately be passed to consumers. He said weak European demand currently limits price increases, sourcing is adapting to import quotas, and Trasteel increased Far East slab purchases after Russian and Ukrainian supply disappeared. He also sees uncertainty deterring new capacity, with shortages such as PPGI more likely met through higher utilisation. No model, product scope, emissions intensity or certificate-price assumption is disclosed for the €5bn figure; it is an executive scenario, not an official estimate.
items.impact_zh: 该观点提示欧洲买方可能把CBAM与配额成本纳入报价和供应地调整，但不能用50亿欧元直接计算中国某一订单税额。报价时仍应按产品CN码、经核验内含排放、已支付碳价和当期证书价格逐单测算，并关注远东板坯竞争与配额可用量。
items.impact_en: The view signals that European buyers may incorporate CBAM and quota costs into pricing and sourcing, but €5bn cannot calculate any Chinese shipment's charge. Price each order using CN scope, verified embedded emissions, eligible carbon price paid and the applicable certificate price, while monitoring Far East slab competition and quota availability.

items.summary_zh: 《每日经济》报道，韩国能率协会咨询受韩国关税厅委托完成“EU CBAM应对支持碳排放量计算程序改善方案”最终报告。报告建议把欧盟规则影响分析、数据库和计算逻辑更新列为经常性运营事项，预先安排年度维护和升级预算，并配置制度专家或年度外部顾问。报道说明本次工作仍是菜单和管理项目的规划设计，实际系统建设需另行开发。文中称欧盟默认值最迟将在2027年12月重新评估，并提到下游扩围提案以2028年1月为目标；这些属于报道对欧盟进程的概述，不是韩国已出台新的强制规则。
items.summary_en: Maeil Business Newspaper reports that Korea Management Association Consultants completed a Korea Customs Service-commissioned final study on improving a CBAM emissions-calculation support programme. It recommends recurring processes and budgets for EU-rule impact analysis, database and calculation-logic updates, plus specialist staff or annual external advice. The work remains a planning and design exercise; actual system development requires a separate project. The article says EU default values are due for reassessment by December 2027 and describes a downstream-extension proposal targeting January 2028; these are reported EU-process points, not a new binding Korean rule.
items.impact_zh: 韩国正在强化对欧出口企业的数据基础设施，可能提升韩国钢企在排放申报和客户服务上的竞争力。中国钢企可借鉴持续更新机制，但不能直接采用韩国系统或其规则判断；应由自身欧盟客户、核查机构和最新欧盟法规确认产品边界、计算逻辑与数据格式。
items.impact_en: Korea is strengthening data infrastructure for EU exporters, potentially improving Korean steelmakers' reporting and customer support. Chinese mills can learn from the recurring-update model but cannot rely on a Korean system or interpretation; confirm scope, calculation logic and data format with EU customers, verifiers and current EU law.

items.summary_zh: 欧委会依据《条例（EU）2016/1036》第11(2)条启动日落复审，案件R877，申请由EUROFER于2026年6月30日代表欧盟产业提交。范围为铁、非合金钢或合金钢（不锈钢除外）热轧、不规则盘卷条杆，涉及CN 7213 10 00、7213 20 00、7213 91 10、7213 91 20、7213 91 41、7213 91 49、7213 91 70、7213 91 90、7213 99 10、7213 99 90、7227 10 00、7227 20 00、7227 90 10、7227 90 50、7227 90 95。现行措施为实施条例（EU）2021/1805项下最终反倾销税。申请人以秘鲁为拟议代表国，主张措施到期可能导致倾销和损害再现。复审调查期为2025年7月1日至2026年6月30日，损害趋势考察期自2023年1月1日起。
items.summary_en: The Commission opened expiry review R877 under Article 11(2) of Regulation (EU) 2016/1036 following a 30 June 2026 request by EUROFER. The product is hot-rolled bars and rods in irregularly wound coils of iron, non-alloy or alloy steel other than stainless, under fifteen listed CN codes in headings 7213 and 7227. Existing definitive duties were imposed by Implementing Regulation (EU) 2021/1805. The applicant proposes Peru as a representative country and alleges likely recurrence of dumping and injury. The review investigation period is 1 July 2025–30 June 2026; the injury trend period starts 1 January 2023.
items.impact_zh: 这是正式立案且应诉窗口正在运行，不是已决定续征或调整税率。中国盘条生产商及关联出口商应立即核对CN范围和案件R877：生产商抽样信息须在公告发布后7日内提交（按日历推算约10月19日，以TRON和欧委会通知为准）；启动意见、听证请求和代表国/投入资料分别有37日、15日和15日期限，事实资料期限为65日。尽快确定欧盟律师、TRON登记主体、关联公司边界、产销量/出口量和投入数据。调查通常12个月内完成，法定最迟约2028年1月12日。
items.impact_en: This is a formal initiation with live participation windows, not a decision to renew or change duty rates. Chinese wire-rod producers and related exporters should immediately verify CN scope and R877. Producer sampling information is due within seven days of publication (about 19 October by calendar count, subject to TRON/Commission instructions); initiation comments, hearing requests and representative-country/input submissions carry 37-, 15- and 15-day windows, while factual normal-value material has 65 days. Confirm EU counsel, TRON registrant, related-party scope and production, sales, export and input data promptly. The review normally ends within 12 months and no later than about 12 January 2028.
items.follow_up: 立即核对R877并在公告后7日抽样窗口内行动；随后跟踪抽样决定、秘鲁代表国意见、问卷、披露和终裁。所有具体截止时点以TRON及欧委会通知为准。

items.title_zh: 中韩钢铁协会会谈：讨论双边贸易、绿色转型及2026年官民对话
items.title_en: Chinese and Korean steel associations discuss bilateral trade, green transition and a 2026 government-industry dialogue
items.title_original: 姜维与韩国钢铁协会执行副会长李京镐举行会谈
items.summary_zh: 中国钢铁工业协会副会长兼秘书长姜维与韩国钢铁协会执行副会长李京镐举行会谈，议题包括两国钢铁业运行、双边钢铁贸易及绿色低碳合作。姜维称中国钢铁业处于减量发展、存量优化阶段，出口呈“量减价升”，并建议通过协会机制和对话处理贸易问题、加强绿色合作；双方还讨论了2026年中韩政府—行业钢铁对话。中方参会者包括中钢协副会长骆铁军、副秘书长苏长永，以及沙钢、首钢代表；韩方包括韩国钢协和POSCO人员。会议没有公布关税、配额、贸易救济或强制性低碳规则。
items.summary_en: CISA vice president and secretary-general Jiang Wei met Korea Iron & Steel Association executive vice president Lee Kyung-ho to discuss industry conditions, bilateral steel trade and green transition. Jiang described China's sector as being in a phase of lower-volume development and stock optimisation, with export volume down and price/value up, and called for association dialogue on trade issues and green cooperation. The parties also discussed a 2026 China-Korea government-industry steel dialogue. CISA, Shagang, Shougang, KOSA and POSCO representatives attended. No tariff, quota, trade-remedy or binding low-carbon rule was announced.
items.impact_zh: 这属于行业协调和前置信号，并非政策落地。首钢等企业可关注2026年官民对话是否涉及韩国贸易救济、原产地、低碳材料标准或供应链合作；在正式文件发布前，不应据会谈推断韩国进口政策或订单条件已改变。
items.impact_en: This is industry coordination and an early signal, not an adopted policy. Shougang and other suppliers should watch whether the 2026 dialogue covers Korean trade remedies, origin, low-carbon material standards or supply-chain cooperation. Do not assume Korean import rules or order terms changed without formal documents.

items.title_zh: SNS模型研究：CBAM对出口型欧洲重工业的保护弱于免费配额，并非现实产量预测
items.title_en: SNS model: CBAM protects export-oriented European heavy industry less than free allocation; not an observed forecast
items.title_original: CBAM undermines the protection of European heavy industry — study
items.summary_zh: SNS 10月8日报告以多部门、多区域CGE模型比较免费配额与类CBAM碳关税。相对“无气候政策”的假设基准，瑞典排放密集、贸易暴露行业产出在碳关税情景下降1.3%，免费配额情景下降0.6%；欧洲其他地区分别下降2.6%和1.3%。模型碳泄漏率为碳关税16.0%、免费配额16.9%，碳关税叠加出口返还时降至10.6%。这些是模型情景结果，不是已观测产量、确定预测或现行法规变更；GMK转述的钢铁下降1.7%也应按部门模型结果理解。
items.summary_en: The 8 October SNS report compares free allocation with CBAM-style carbon tariffs in a multi-sector, multi-region CGE model. Relative to a hypothetical no-policy baseline, Swedish EITE output falls 1.3% with tariffs versus 0.6% with free allocation; the rest of Europe falls 2.6% versus 1.3%. Modelled leakage is 16.0% with tariffs, 16.9% with free allocation and 10.6% when export rebates are added. These are scenario results, not observed output, a firm forecast or a regulatory change; GMK's 1.7% steel figure is likewise a sector-model result.
items.impact_zh: 研究可能强化欧盟出口型钢企争取出口补偿或调整CBAM设计的政策诉求，但目前没有改变进口商的CBAM义务、证书安排或具体税费。中国钢厂可关注未来咨询和立法讨论，不应把模型百分比直接用于订单需求、到岸成本或税额测算。
items.impact_en: The study may strengthen EU exporters' calls for export relief or CBAM redesign, but it does not change current importer obligations, certificates or charges. Chinese mills should monitor consultations and legislation without using model percentages as shipment demand, landed cost or tax estimates.

items.summary_zh: RINA于9月30日公告，其已取得ACCREDIA对CBAM核查活动的认可，并称其为ACCREDIA首家获此认可的机构、也是全球首批之一。公告称实际排放数据采用时须由获认可的CBAM核查机构验证，并列出2026年9月开始核查活动、2027年2月起可购买证书及2027年9月30日完成首次申报和清缴等节点。这是RINA自身公告；本轮未在ACCREDIA证书附件中独立确认全部行业、国家和活动范围。
items.summary_en: RINA announced on 30 September that ACCREDIA had accredited it for CBAM verification, describing itself as ACCREDIA's first such body and among the first worldwide. It says accredited verification is required when actual emissions are used and lists September 2026 verification activity, February 2027 certificate availability and the first declaration/surrender by 30 September 2027. The full sectoral and geographic certificate scope was not independently confirmed in ACCREDIA's annex.

items.title_zh: 美国贸易代表办公室就欧盟CBAM及下游扩围征求意见，11月9日截止
items.title_en: USTR seeks comments on EU CBAM and downstream expansion; submissions due 9 November
items.title_original: USTR Seeks Business Input on the EU Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism
items.summary_zh: 美国贸易代表办公室（USTR）以《联邦公报》通知（91 FR 64450，案卷USTR-2026-0661）征求欧盟CBAM对美国生产商、工人、直接和间接出口及美欧贸易的现有和潜在影响。问题覆盖合规成本、监管负担、欧盟市场准入、欧委会/理事会/欧洲议会下游扩围方案的影响、相对欧盟及第三国企业的竞争效果，以及是否应采取何种执法行动。通知说明扩围仍在三方谈判，尚未形成最终欧盟法律。意见须在2026年11月9日23:59（美国东部时间）前通过Regulations.gov提交，案卷号USTR-2026-0661。
items.summary_en: USTR's Federal Register notice (91 FR 64450; docket USTR-2026-0661) seeks evidence on the current and potential effects of EU CBAM on U.S. producers, workers, direct and indirect exports and U.S.-EU trade. It asks about compliance cost, regulatory burden, EU market access, the Commission/Council/Parliament downstream-extension proposals, competitive effects versus EU and third-country firms, and whether enforcement action may be appropriate. The extension remains in trilogue and is not final EU law. Comments are due through Regulations.gov by 11:59 p.m. ET on 9 November 2026.
items.impact_zh: 这不是美国已对欧盟或中国钢材采取新关税，而是正式取证程序。其问题设置表明美国可能把CBAM合规负担和下游扩围纳入对欧交涉或后续贸易执法评估。中国钢企虽非征询重点对象，也应让美国及欧盟客户分别量化CN产品、实际排放/默认值差额、核查成本、订单流失与供应链传导，避免把三方机构各自的扩围清单当成最终范围。
items.impact_en: This is a formal evidence-gathering process, not a new U.S. tariff on EU or Chinese steel. Its questions show that the United States may use CBAM compliance burdens and downstream expansion in EU engagement or later trade-enforcement assessment. Chinese mills should help U.S. and EU customers quantify CN products, actual-versus-default emissions, verification cost, lost orders and supply-chain pass-through, while not treating any institution's trilogue position as final scope.

items.title_zh: Gerber Group观点：欧盟钢铁配额快速耗尽或挤压中小进口商
items.title_en: Gerber Group argues rapid EU steel-quota exhaustion disadvantages smaller importers
items.title_original: Thorsten Gerber: Who Really Eats the EU Steel Quotas
items.summary_zh: Gerber Group首席执行官Thorsten Gerber在企业自办媒体采访中称，新钢铁措施使免税进口量减少47%、配额外税率为50%，部分供应国第四季度配额在5天内申报超量；他主张当前先到先得且无单一进口商上限的分配方式有利于大型进口商，并指称部分欧盟钢厂也大量进口。文章还批评欧洲议会拟把CBAM扩至457项下游产品，并建议为中小企业预留配额或设置进口商上限。文章未提供按产品类别和原产地的TARIC配额使用明细、EORI分配数据或计算方法，且网站声明部分内容为观点或互联网信息，因此这些数字和归因属于企业立场，不是欧委会监测结论。
items.summary_en: In an interview on its own trade-news site, Gerber Group CEO Thorsten Gerber says the new steel measure cuts duty-free volume by 47%, applies a 50% out-of-quota duty and left some supplier-country Q4 quotas oversubscribed within five days. He argues first-come-first-served allocation without an importer cap favours large importers and alleges that EU mills also import heavily. He also criticises Parliament's proposed CBAM extension to 457 downstream products and calls for SME reservations or importer caps. The article supplies no category/origin TARIC utilisation data, EORI allocation data or calculation method, and the site disclaims that some content is opinion or internet information; the claims are a company position, not a Commission monitoring conclusion.
items.impact_zh: 对中小进口商和中国出口商的实际风险在于特定产品类别、原产地和季度的配额可能迅速转入等待分配或触发配额外税，但不能把“5天”外推到全部配额。每票出运前应核对TARIC配额余额、分配状态、原产地与产品分类，并在合同中明确配额耗尽、等待分配和税负承担；对47%、457项及大型企业占用比例应以正式法规、三方谈判文本和官方配额数据复核。
items.impact_en: The practical risk for SMEs and Chinese exporters is that a specific product/origin/quarter quota may rapidly move into waiting allocation or incur the out-of-quota duty; the five-day claim cannot be generalised to all quotas. Before shipment, verify TARIC balance and allocation status, origin and product classification, and allocate quota-exhaustion, waiting-allocation and duty risk in the contract. Check the 47%, 457-product and importer-concentration claims against legislation, trilogue texts and official quota data.

items.summary_zh: 决定2026/2256于9月24日通过并生效，10月8日刊登公报，确定欧盟在EEA联合委员会的立场。附件是拟议的冰岛、挪威CBAM登记册及海关系统技术和财务安排，列支系统开发、运行与预算分摊；不能据此认定附件联合委员会决定已通过。
items.summary_en: Decision 2026/2256 was adopted and entered into force on 24 September, published on 8 October. It sets the EU's EEA Joint Committee position. The attached draft concerns Iceland/Norway registry, customs IT and cost sharing; it is not evidence that the joint decision has been adopted.

items.title_en: CBAM accreditation update: seven bodies accept third-country applications, previously five
items.title_original: State-of-play CBAM accreditation
items.summary_zh: 欧委会两页进展表现列24家国家认可机构同意提供CBAM认可、18家准备受理申请、7家同意认可第三国申请人且已开始受理；相比9月29日版本，准备受理及已受理第三国申请机构分别由16、5增至18、7。第三国受理机构为法国COFRAC、希腊ESYD、意大利Accredia、荷兰RvA、波兰PCA、斯洛伐克SNAS、瑞典Swedac。罗马尼亚RENAR、斯洛文尼亚SA仍标为未准备受理，分别备注2026年10月、11月，不能据月份认定已启动。荷兰及瑞典另有分别涉及土耳其TURKAK、乌克兰NAAU的协议备注。
items.summary_en: The updated Commission table lists 24 bodies offering CBAM accreditation, 18 ready for applications and seven agreeing to accredit and already accepting third-country applicants, versus 16 and five in the 29 September version. The seven are COFRAC, ESYD, Accredia, RvA, PCA, SNAS and Swedac. RENAR and SA remain marked not ready, with October and November 2026 notes respectively; the notes do not establish commencement. RvA and Swedac have agreement notes concerning TURKAK and NAAU.
items.impact_zh: 中国核验机构可向上述国家认可机构确认申请资格、程序和适用条件；钢厂选服务商时应查有效认可证书、钢铁产品／活动范围和官方名录。本表描述受理渠道，不证明特定检测公司已获认可或覆盖全部CBAM行业，签约前应留存证书及范围证据。
items.impact_en: Chinese verifier applicants can confirm eligibility and procedures with these bodies. Mills should check valid certificates, steel activity scope and official listings before contracting. Application readiness does not prove that any individual company is accredited across all CBAM sectors.

items.title_zh: 欧盟理事会确定将CBAM纳入EEA的谈判立场：附件仍待联合委员会通过
items.title_en: Council sets the EU position on incorporating CBAM into the EEA; annex remains a draft
items.title_original: Council Decision (EU) 2026/2240 of 24 September 2026 on the position to be adopted, on behalf of the European Union, within the EEA Joint Committee concerning an amendment to Annex XX (Environment) to the EEA Agreement (CBAM) (Text with EEA relevance)
items.summary_zh: 理事会决定（EU）2026/2240于9月24日通过并生效，10月6日刊登公报，确定欧盟在EEA联合委员会中的立场。所附联合委员会决定仍明确标为草案，拟把条例（EU）2023/956及其简化修订2025/2083纳入EEA，并要求冰岛、挪威等EFTA国家在非优惠原产地、CN/TARIC对应编码、海关数据报送和CBAM登记册等方面与欧盟保持一致。草案拟在联合委员会通过且满足通知条件后生效，不能把理事会立场当成附件已经通过。
items.summary_en: Council Decision (EU) 2026/2240, adopted and effective on 24 September and published on 6 October, establishes the Union position in the EEA Joint Committee. Its annex is expressly a draft Joint Committee decision to incorporate Regulations (EU) 2023/956 and 2025/2083, align EFTA-state origin and tariff classifications, customs data and registry operation. The draft still requires Joint Committee adoption and its notification conditions.
items.impact_zh: 向冰岛、挪威出口的钢厂和贸易商应跟踪EEA联合委员会正式决定及当地配套法，不应据本理事会决定提前认定所有CBAM申报义务已经在当地生效；同时准备与欧盟一致的CN编码、非优惠原产地和排放数据。
items.impact_en: Exporters to Iceland and Norway should track the final EEA Joint Committee decision and local implementation rather than treating all obligations as already effective. Prepare EU-aligned CN classification, non-preferential origin and emissions data.
items.coverage: 已读官方CELEX全文及附件，核对第1—2条、草案序言、原产地／编码／海关数据安排和草案生效条款；未核验后续EEA联合委员会是否已经采纳。

items.title_en: US corrects Chinese drawn stainless-steel sink sunset-review rate to 8.51%
items.title_original: Drawn Stainless Steel Sinks From the People's Republic of China: Final Results of the Expedited First and Second Sunset Reviews of the Countervailing Duty Order; Correction
items.summary_zh: 10月6日公告2026-20481纠正2018和2023两次反补贴日落复审终裁中的错误：其他企业补贴率原写8.61%，应为8.51%。这是历史公告数字更正，不是对所有中国钢材新增税率。
items.summary_en: Notice 2026-20481 corrects the all-others subsidy rate in the 2018 and 2023 sunset results from 8.61% to 8.51%. It is a correction of historical notices.
items.impact_zh: 水槽出口及美国进口商应更新案件档案，由律师核对现行保证金、清算指令及历史记录，不能直接把8.51%当所有企业当前税率。
items.impact_en: Update case records and have counsel check current deposits and liquidation instructions. Do not apply 8.51% indiscriminately.

items.source_excerpt: The U.S. Department of Commerce (Commerce) published notice in the Federal Register of July 25, 2018 and October 20, 2023 in which Commerce announced the final results of the first and second sunset reviews of the countervailing duty (CVD) order on drawn stainless steel sinks from the People's Republic of China (China). These notices incorrectly stated an all-others rate of 8.61 percent.
